title: Protocol for the isolation of mouse muscle stem cells using fluorescence-activated cell sorting
protocol: Prepare Digest 1 mix containing 0.2% Collagenase Type II dissolved in DMEM.
Pass digest 1 solution through a filtered tissue culture bottle and keep on ice until step 8.
Clean the dissection field with 70% ethanol.
Transfer 20 ml of Digest 1 mix into a tube labeled Digest 1 for each replicate mouse. Keep tubes on ice.
Euthanize mice according to approved IACUC protocol.
Spray down mouse with 70% ethanol, remove skin, and extract hindlimb skeletal muscle.
Place extracted muscles in tube containing ice-cold Digest 1 mix.
Create a transverse incision along the waist and peel away skin and underlying fascia to access skeletal muscles.
Digest 1 mix.
Seal the tube containing Digest 1 and muscle with parafilm.
Keep the tube on ice until step 8.
Disinfect dissection tools and dissection platform between each mouse with 70% ethanol to avoid cross-contamination of samples.
Disinfect tubes with 70% ethanol.
Incubate tube(s) containing Digest 1 and muscle at 37°C in a shaking water bath set to 55 RPM for 90 minutes.
Use weighted rings to secure 50 mL conical tubes to the bottom of the shaking bath during incubation.
Prepare glass tips (one per mouse) by safely breaking off the thin barrel of a glass Pasteur pipet and attaching a latex bulb over the broken opening.
Label two 50 mL conical tubes per mouse.
Prepare 5 mL of Digest 1 stop solution (20% FBS or DBS in F10) for each mouse.
Remove floating debris from Digest 1 tubes by carefully decanting each tube.
Add 5 mL of Digest 1 stop solution to each tube to inactivate Digest 1.
Gently swirl the tube(s) to mix thoroughly.
Carefully add 25 mL of PBS to each Digest 1 tube by pipetting to the wall of the tube.
Slowly decant the supernatant, leaving only a little liquid covering the muscle.
Repeat the previous steps two more times to remove residual Digest 1 Mix.
Pour all muscles into a petri dish that contains 25 mL of PBS to start the trituration process.
Gently triturate the largest muscles.
Mince several times for each muscle.
Collect all solution from the petri dish using a serological pipet.
Split collected solution equally into two 50 mL collection tubes for each mouse.
Add 25 mL of PBS into the petri dish for a second round of mincing.
Triturate smaller muscles.
Repeat step (mincing and trituration) for successive rounds.
Add 25 mL of PBS into each dish for a third round of mincing.
Triturate all muscles.
Fill up each sedimentation collection tube to 50 mL with PBS.
Place all tubes upright in a stationary 37°C incubator for 25 min for gravitational sedimentation.
Label one 50 mL conical tube per mouse and keep the tube on ice.
Collect the interstitial cells (ICs), including MuSCs liberated early from myofibers after Digest 1, and use them for single-color and fluorescent-minus-one controls.
Carefully remove the collection tubes from the incubator.
Collect 15 mL of supernatant from each tube and deposit the solution into the ICs tube(s) and leave on ice.
Pipette onto the side of the wall for each tube.
Incubate the collection tubes for 15 min at 37°C.
Prepare Digest 2 mix (0.0125% Collagenase Type II/0.05% Dispase II in F10).
Keep Digest 2 mix at 37°C until needed.
Filter Digest 2 mix through a filtered tissue culture bottle.
Carefully remove 20 mL of supernatant from each sedimentation tube.
Gently add 20 mL of fresh PBS into the tube without disturbing sediment.
Incubate the sedimentation tubes for 10 min at 37°C.
Gently remove supernatant to the 15 mL mark for each tube.
Add 15 mL of pre-warmed Digest 2 mix to each tube.
Seal each tube with parafilm.
Incubate tubes at 37°C in a shaking water bath (55 RPM) for 30 min.
Immediately add 2 mL of Fetal Bovine Serum or Donor Bovine Serum to each tube after 30 min.
Gently swirl the tube to mix.
Quickly pipette the digested fibers up and down 10 times with a 25 mL serological pipet.
Centrifuge tubes for 15 s (40 × g) at 4°C to sediment leftover debris.
Collect the supernatant from each tube.
Filter the supernatant through a 70 μm cell strainer placed in a new 50 mL tube labeled according to each mouse replicate.
Centrifuge each tube for 5 min at 4°C (400 × g).
Remove supernatant and resuspend mono-nuclear cells in 0.5–1 mL of solution.
Count cells on a hemocytometer.
Count ICs for the single-color/Fluorescent minus one (FMO) control samples.
Triturate large hindlimb muscles gently.
Mince each muscle several times during trituration.
Use antibody staining to negatively exclude fibro-adipogenic progenitors (FAPs), endothelial cells, and blood cells.
Enrich for PAX7-positive MuSCs using positive selection cell surface markers CD29 and CXCR4.
Label 5 mL FACS tubes for unstained, single-color controls (SSC), and fluorescence-minus-one (FMO) controls.
Transfer 4e6 cells to their respective FACS tubes in a final volume of 400 μL of SM.
Stain cells in control and experimental samples with fluorescently conjugated antibodies according to the staining scheme.
Shield stained cells from light and keep tubes partially immersed in ice.
Incubate stained cells on ice for 30 min.
Wash stained cells by adding 3 mL of SM to each FACS tube.
Centrifuge the tubes.
Centrifuge tubes at 360 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Decant the supernatant and resuspend in 400 μL of SM.
Incubate stained cells with PE-Cy7 Streptavidin antibody for 20 min on ice.
Wash stained cells by adding 3 mL of SM to each tube.
Centrifuge (360 × g) for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant and repeat the wash step one additional time, for 2 washes in total.
Filter cells through a 40 μm cell strainer into freshly labeled FACS tubes.
Keep stained cells on ice in the tubes.
Filter cells through a 40 μm cell strainer 15 min prior to FACS analysis.
Add PI and Calcein Blue to corresponding tubes 15 min prior to FACS.
Set up the BD FACS Aria III cytometer as specified by the manufacturer.
Use a 70 μm nozzle with a flow rate of 2.0–4.0.
Run unstained control to set the background voltage for each channel.
Run single-color control (SCC) samples and set voltage for positive cells.
Record events for the top 25% of expressing cells for fluorophore compensations.
Compensate for all channels.
Run fluorescence minus one (FMO) samples to assist with drawing negative gates for APC (CD45, CD11b, TER119, SCA1, CD31).
Draw positive gates for APC-Cy7 (β1 Integrin) and PE-Cy7 (CXCR4).
Sort CD45-; Cd11b-; TER119-; SCA1-; CD31-; β1 Integrin+; CXCR4+ MuSCs for further analysis.
Freshly sorted MuSCs will appear as small, rounded cells that divide over the next 48–72 hours as they exit quiescence.
Pre-coat wells with coating media for 24 hours prior to FACS.
Sort freshly isolated MuSCs directly into pre-coated wells containing growth medium (GM).
Supplement cultured MuSCs daily with 5 ng/mL bFGF and incubate at 37°C in a 5% CO2 environment.
After 3 days of culturing, remove half the volume of GM and replace it with fresh GM.
Repeat the process of replacing half the volume of GM three times.
After 5 days of culturing, detach MuSCs from plates by removing half the volume of GM and replacing it with an equal volume of warmed 5 mM EDTA.
Incubate plates for 20 min at 37°C.
Confirm that more than 90% of cells have been detached under a microscope.
Use a pipette to wash the bottom of each plate to gently push cells into a cell suspension.
Transfer the cell suspension to a labeled 15 mL conical tube and centrifuge (360 × g) for 5 min at 4°C.
Resuspend the resulting pellet in GM to count cells in the suspension.
Seed cells at the appropriate density and continue culturing in GM.
Supplement with daily additions of bFGF.
Seed approximately 8,000 cells into 96-well plates containing DM without bFGF.
Culture the cells in DM for 48–72 hours to differentiate myoblasts into fully formed myotubes.
Prepare an RNase-free environment on the lab bench and label 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes.
Aliquot 500 μL of TRIzol LS into each tube.
Sort 1–50,000 MuSCs into 500 μL of TRIzol LS.
Immediately vortex the tube(s).
Add 250 μL of TRIzol LS to bring volume to 750 μL.
Incubate tubes with RNA/TRIzol for 5 minutes at 25°C.
Store RNA in TRIzol LS at -80°C for up to 2–3 months.
Perform extraction of RNA according to the manufacturer’s protocol (TRIzol LS).
Remove half the volume of GM from each well.
Add back the same volume with 8% paraformaldehyde to achieve a final concentration of 4% PFA.
Incubate MuSCs at room temperature (RT) for 20 minutes.
Stop fixation by washing cells with Phosphate Buffered Saline (PBS) containing 0.1% Tween 20 (PBST) three times for five minutes each.
Permeabilize cells with 0.3% Triton-X for 20 minutes at 25°C.
Wash cells with PBST three times for five minutes each.
Add blocking buffer (containing 5% Normal Goat Serum, 3% BSA, and 0.3% Triton-X in PBS) to the wells and incubate for two hours at RT.
Without washing, add primary antibody in blocking buffer to each well and incubate overnight at 4°C.
Remove primary antibody solution and wash cells four times for fifteen minutes with PBST at 25°C.
Add secondary antibody in blocking buffer to the wells and incubate for one hour at 25°C.
Remove the secondary antibody from solution by washing cells with PBST four times for fifteen minutes at 25°C.
Add Hoechst stain (1 μg/mL Hoechst in PBS) to the cells and incubate for fifteen minutes at 25°C.
Alternatively, add Hoechst into the third wash step.
Remove Hoechst stain solution and wash cells with PBST for five minutes.
Titrate the virus to determine the optimal density for maximal transduction and minimal toxicity.
Make virus in 293T cells.
Concentrate virus with PEG-it viral precipitation reagent.
Resuspend concentrated virus in GM supplemented with 25 mM HEPES.
Sort 3,000 MuSCs into coated wells of a 96 well plate containing 200 μL of GM.
Prepare diluted lentiviral stock by diluting lentivirus solution with 8 μg/mL Polybrene.
Remove half the volume of GM from each well and add back an equal volume of diluted viral media.
Pipette each well five times with a P200 pipet.
Incubate the plate for 15 minutes at 37°C.
Quickly parafilm plates shut to prevent spilling of virus while spinning cells.
Centrifuge plates at 930 × g for 90 minutes at 32°C.
Wash out virus by removing half volume (100 μL) and replacing with fresh GM eight times.
Add bFGF to each well to achieve a final concentration of 5 ng/mL.
Return the wells to 37°C daily after adding bFGF.
Inject a chemical agent into the Tibialis Anterior muscle of mice according to your institution’s IACUC protocol, 24 hours prior to transplantation, to induce injury.
Sort MuSCs at desired numbers into 500 μL of staining media in Eppendorf tubes and keep on ice.
Pellet cells by spinning them down at 400 × g for 5 minutes.
Remove the supernatant after pelleting.
Resuspend cells in approximately 25 μL of saline.
Pre-coat the BD Biosciences syringe with FBS to prevent cells from sticking to the plastic walls of the syringe.
Take in 25 μL of cells (in saline) into the insulin syringe using a 31-gauge needle.
Inject the needle at a 25° angle for a few centimeters, then reduce the injection angle.
Inject the entire volume slowly into the mid belly of the TA muscle.
Slowly remove the needle from the TA muscle after injection.
Dispose of the needle in a sharps bin.
